_about: Plan this ride: the practical facts for riding a scenic route, each with its official source, the date it was checked and, where it can lapse, validUntil (YYYY-MM-DD). A test fails once a validUntil has passed, so a stale fact cannot ship. Nothing here is estimated; a fact we could not read on an official page is left out. Fares are the one-way adult fare for the stated section, as shown by the operator on the checked date.

board.text: Board at either end: Fujisawa or Kamakura. The sea views are between Koshigoe and Inamuragasaki, so ride the whole line.

access.text: JR Tokaido Line to Fujisawa, or JR Yokosuka Line to Kamakura and ride the Enoden from that end.
Odakyu Line to Fujisawa. The Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass covers this trip and the Enoden.

reservation.text: No seat reservations: board any train.

operation.text: Regular trains all day. Check the station timetables for times.

tickets.text: Single ticket: ticket machines at every Enoden station.
Noriorikun one-day pass, ¥800 adult: ride the whole Enoden as often as you like on the day you buy it, from the ticket machines at all Enoden stations.
Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass: from Odakyu stations or online, one day, including the Odakyu trip to Fujisawa and back.

enoden-coast.officialLanguage: The Enoden site has an English version: https://www.enoden.co.jp/en/

board.text: Board at Torokko Saga, the brick building next to JR Saga-Arashiyama Station, or at Torokko Kameoka at the other end. The gorge is along the whole ride.

access.text: JR Sagano Line to Saga-Arashiyama, then walk next door to Torokko Saga.

ride.text: About 25 minutes one way, Torokko Saga to Torokko Kameoka.

fare.text: ¥880 adult, ¥440 child, one way — the same for any section.
fare.expiryNote: Fares and times may change with the new cars from March 1, 2027.

reservation.text: All seats are reserved. Book online from midnight Japan time one month before your ride, or buy same-day tickets at the station counters (not at Torokko Hozukyo); standing tickets are sold once seats run out.

operation.text: 2026 season runs until December 29. No trains January 1–February 28, December 30–31 and on some Wednesdays — check the calendar. New cars start on March 1, 2027.

tickets.text: Official online booking, one month ahead.
The JR Pass is not valid on this train.

sagano-gorge.officialLanguage: The Sagano Scenic Railway site has English pages; the yearly calendar and timetable are Japanese PDFs.

board.text: Board at Shimbashi and ride to Toyosu (or the other way). The Rainbow Bridge loop is between Shibaura-futo and Odaiba-kaihinkoen.

access.text: Shimbashi: change from the JR Yamanote Line or the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line. Toyosu: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line.

fare.text: ¥390 adult with a paper ticket (¥388 with an IC card), Shimbashi–Toyosu one way.

reservation.text: No seat reservations. The line is driverless: the seats at the very front look straight down the track — first come, first served.

operation.text: Runs every day. Check service status before you go.

tickets.text: Single tickets from station machines, or tap an IC card, credit card or phone at the gate.
One-day ticket, ¥820 adult, sold as a QR mobile ticket for unlimited rides on the whole line.

yurikamome-night.officialLanguage: The Yurikamome site is mainly in Japanese, with English and other language versions linked from the top page.
